verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents issuing, topping up, revealing and cancelling virtual cards (VCN). It has a CUSTOM type explicitly intended for "one card per supplier", with its own limit and adjustable controls and window. Marketing also promotes 1-click virtual cards with per-purpose limits, specifically for software spend. missing for 10: explicit evidence that a card is merchant-locked so it is rejected at other vendors, detail on what the adjustable controls cover, any coverage of procurement beyond SaaS, independent or hands-on corroboration.
